Explore

Discover Thamesmead’s rich history spanning more than five decades. Our archive is filled with stories, photographs, interviews, newsletters, videos and more, contributed by residents past and present, local and London wide archives.

If you have been inspired or intrigued by the stories, the people or the content we have added some tips and links so you can take your research further.

Stories

Immerse yourself in Thamesmead’s vibrant past. These stories are curated by our archive team, covering a range of specific topics from the utopian masterplans that start the Thamesmead story to key cultural moments like the filming of Beautiful Thing.

View all stories

Collections

Browse an area or category you are interested in and unearth a broad range of related materials.

View all collections

Map

Search areas of our interactive map to learn more about different areas of Thamesmead and how they have changed over the years. 

Explore the map
